Markets.title: Global Market: China stocks rally 1% as Trump-Xi meeting raises trade hopes
Markets.summary: Chinese stock markets rose one percent due to investor optimism regarding upcoming trade discussions between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. Technology and semiconductor sectors led the gains, while Hong Kong equities also advanced.

Markets.title: Motilal Oswal sees surging steel prices to offset cost inflation for metal majors. Here are its top stock picks
Markets.summary: Motilal Oswal expects surging steel prices, lean inventories, and resilient demand to help domestic steelmakers offset cost inflation. The brokerage named JSW Steel and Tata Steel as its top stock picks due to their cost advantages and raw-material access.

Markets.title: Even JPMorgan can’t predict oil’s next move as Iran war crosses more red lines
Markets.summary: JPMorgan says it can no longer predict oil prices due to escalating Middle East tensions and supply risks. Although Brent crude remains above $100 a barrel, demand and inventory buffers have helped the market absorb disruptions.

Markets.title: GPT Infraprojects shares surge 9% after securing Rs 484 crore railway order from RVNL
Markets.summary: GPT Infraprojects shares surged nearly 9% after winning a Rs 484 crore railway bridge order from RVNL. This contract pushed the company's total order book to Rs 4,992 crore.

Markets.title: India bonds little changed, debt auction cutoff to guide
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds remained steady as traders awaited new debt supply cutoffs. The Reserve Bank of India planned open market debt sales to absorb excess liquidity and improve monetary policy transmission.

Markets.title: How Bessent, America's bond salesman, cornered Japan on big spending
Markets.summary: US Treasury Secretary Bessent urged Japan to reform its fiscal and monetary policies to stabilize the yen and reduce market fluctuations. In response, Japan's finance minister sought American backing for yen support during their discussions.

Geo-Political.title: Canada welcomes EU proposal to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has welcomed a European Union proposal for Canada to become an associate member. He stated that this alliance would serve as a beacon for other democracies.

Geo-Political.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
Geo-Political.summary: South African police are investigating a string of deaths after the ninth woman's body was discovered. Authorities have cautioned against assuming all the killings are linked, though many women in the area remain afraid.

Geo-Political.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
Geo-Political.summary: UN experts state there are grounds to believe the United States committed war crimes during February strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd. The U.S. has not acknowledged carrying out these deadly attacks.

Geo-Political.title: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
Geo-Political.summary: The United States will permit an Iranian delegation, including President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, to enter the country for United Nations meetings in New York. This diplomatic development occurs as the ongoing war reaches the six-month mark.

Geo-Political.title: Wife of US scholar jailed in China asks Trump to raise arrest at Xi meeting
Geo-Political.summary: Sylvia Zin and other family members of individuals imprisoned in China are asking President Trump to raise their relatives' cases during his upcoming meeting with China's leader. Zin's husband, a U.S. scholar, is among those currently jailed in China.

Geo-Political.title: Hyrox athlete apologises for continuing race after soiling herself
Geo-Political.summary: Joanna Wietrzyk has apologized for continuing to race after accidentally soiling herself during a Hyrox fitness competition last week. She has also forfeited her victory in the event as a result of the incident.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without paying for advertising. This experiment demonstrated a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create various types of AI content. In addition to content generation, the platform provides creators with tools to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why India and Canada are pitching for a CEPA by end-2026
Data & Insights.summary: India and Canada are aiming to finalize a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) by the end of 2026. This initiative is designed to strengthen economic ties after a period of strained bilateral relations.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's raises India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7% on Middle East resilience, but risks remain
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's raised India's fiscal 2027 GDP growth forecast to 7%, citing resilience despite Middle East challenges. However, the agency warned that high energy and El Niño-related food prices still pose risks to inflation, consumption, and growth.

Data & Insights.title: Centre to hold state finance ministers’ conference ahead of GST Council meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The central government is hosting a state finance ministers' conference titled “Financing India’s Journey towards Viksit Bharat.” This meeting precedes the October 7 GST Council session and the start of Union Budget 2027-28 pre-budget consultations on October 12.

Data & Insights.title: PM Modi turns 76: Demonetisation, GST, PLI, Jan Dhan and more – Key economic policies rolled out since 2014
Data & Insights.summary: Since taking office in May 2014, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has implemented major economic reforms, including demonetisation, GST, and the PLI scheme. His administration has also driven welfare expansion, technological transformation, national-security shifts, and policy changes.

Data & Insights.title: Exclusive | Big change soon in how people earn, invest as salaried white-collar jobs set to decline: Saurabh Mukherjea
Data & Insights.summary: Saurabh Mukherjea states that artificial intelligence will soon automate repetitive white-collar jobs and reshape the employment landscape. This shift will significantly change how people earn and invest, promoting a transition toward gig work in India.

Data & Insights.title: India’s US Treasury purchases surge to $15.2 billion in July, highest holdings in 10 months
Data & Insights.summary: India increased its US Treasury holdings by $15.2 billion in July, reaching its highest level in 10 months. This surge was driven by large capital inflows from the central bank's special facilities designed to attract overseas funds.

India.title: "First Day Matters": iPhone Lovers Queue Up Across India
India.summary: Apple launched its new iPhones in India with eager customers queuing up at physical stores. On launch day, these stores opened early at 8 a.m. and will remain open until 10 p.m.

India.title: Video: Long Queues Outside Apple Stores In India As Sale Of New iPhones Begins
India.summary: Long queues formed outside Apple stores in India as the newly launched iPhone series officially went on sale. Customers gathered to purchase the latest iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models.

India.title: DUSU Elections 2026: Voting Begins Amid Tight Security, Over 1.5 Lakh Students To Cast Votes
India.summary: Voting for the 2026 Delhi University Students' Union elections has begun with tight security across the campus. More than 150 polling booths have been established to accommodate over 1.5 lakh eligible student voters.

India.title: Bank Holiday Today: Check If Banks Are Open Or Closed In Your State
India.summary: Indian banks have experienced multiple closures this month across various regions due to festivals and other occasions. Customers should check local schedules to confirm if banks are open in their specific state today.

India.title: Kerala Widens Lionel Messi Event Probe, Ex-Sports Minister Likely To Be Quizzed
India.summary: Kerala is investigating alleged financial irregularities regarding the previous government's plans to host Argentina's national football team featuring Lionel Messi in Kochi in 2025. The former sports minister is likely to be questioned as part of this ongoing probe.

India.title: DUSU Elections 2026 Live Updates: Delhi BJP Chief Says ABVP Will Win All 4 Seats
India.summary: Voting for the DUSU Elections 2026 is underway with tight security across polling centers for 1,51,842 eligible students. Delhi's BJP chief has expressed confidence that the ABVP will win all four contested seats.

General.title: Twenty women had breasts removed unnecessarily during cancer treatment, NHS trust admits
General.summary: An NHS trust in County Durham admitted that twenty women unnecessarily had their breasts removed during cancer treatment. These patients were part of a larger group of hundreds harmed by their care at the health trust.

General.title: Charles 'sounded giddily elated' after Diana died, Earl Spencer claims
General.summary: Earl Spencer claims in a new book that then-Prince Charles was giddily elated following the death of Princess Diana. Buckingham Palace has strongly pushed back against these claims.

General.title: War may be coming. Are we psychologically ready?
General.summary: Military and government officials warn that the risk of a major conflict is increasing. However, experts suggest that the general public is currently not mentally prepared for such a war.

General.title: US fans with Ed Sheeran tickets left 'torn' over Macklemore controversy
General.summary: US fans holding tickets for Ed Sheeran's upcoming concert this weekend are conflicted about whether to attend due to a controversy involving Macklemore. The ticket holders expressed feeling torn over the situation ahead of the weekend performance.

General.title: British woman rescued in Malawi shootout that left four suspected kidnappers dead
General.summary: A British mother of two was rescued in Malawi after being kidnapped last week in the city of Blantyre. A shootout during the rescue operation left four suspected kidnappers dead.
